listen_address.description: IP address CUPS listens on for incoming connections (use 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

listen_port.description: Port number for HTTP connections (standard IPP port).

server_name.description: Hostname advertised for this CUPS server (for DNS-SD and web UI).

server_admin.description: Email address of the CUPS server administrator.

access_log_path.description: Path to the file where access logs are stored.

error_log_path.description: Path to the file where error logs are stored.

page_log_path.description: Path to the file where page logs are stored.

browsing_enabled.description: Enable/discover printers via DNS-SD and web interface.

shared_printers.description: Allow shared printers to be accessed by remote clients.

max_clients_per_host.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed per client IP.

max_clients.description: Total maximum number of concurrent client connections.

max_hold_time.description: Maximum time (in seconds) jobs can be held before automatic deletion (0 = unlimited).

max_job_time.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a job can remain active (0 = unlimited).

default_auth_type.description: Default authentication method for administrative and web operations.

listen_local_only.description: If true, restricts listening to the Unix socket only (enhances security).

https_port.description: Port for HTTPS/IPP-over-TLS (set to 0 to disable TLS).

server_certificate.description: Path to the SSL/TLS server certificate file.

server_key.description: Path to the SSL/TLS server private key file.

trusted_certificates.description: Comma-separated list of paths to trusted CA certificate files for TLS.

items.description: Path to a trusted CA certificate file.

auth_realms.description: Access control rules for different CUPS locations (e.g., /admin, /admin/conf).

order.description: Order in which Allow/Deny rules are applied.

items.description: Allowed client patterns (IP, subnet, or hostname).

allow_list.description: List of allowed client addresses or patterns.

deny_list.description: List of denied client addresses or patterns.

require_user.description: List of allowed usernames (for auth-enabled locations).

policies.description: Printer job policies (e.g., for default, admin, or custom queues).

operations.description: List of allowed operations (lowercase variants accepted by CUPS).

default_printer_options.description: Global default options applied to newly added printers.

log_filters.description: Filter rules for log processing (e.g., MIME handling).

command.description: Command to run for filtering (path to filter binary).
